metadata.title: Golden Hour Portrait with Metallic Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned close-up portrait of a woman with a shimmering, glitter-infused skin texture, featuring large metallic hoop earrings and a bold, beveled gold serif title at the bottom left.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm sepia lighting unifies the subject's skin, hair, and the gold typography.
The sharp, metallic glint on the earring mirrors the specular highlights in the eyes and lips.
The heavy grain texture provides a tactile, analog film quality to the digital composition.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm color palette (oranges, browns, golds)
Extreme close-up framing focusing on the face and jewelry
Heavy film grain and glitter overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centered and fills approximately 80% of the frame, tilted slightly to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the large, sparkling hoop earring serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the eyes, moves down to the lips, follows the curve of the earring, and rests on the bottom-left typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily dark shadows in the upper corners and hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and copper tones for skin and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep espresso and black for shadows and hair definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright gold for the typography and earring glints.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a monochromatic warm spectrum

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Wide, open counters in the 'O' and 'G'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' features a sharp, downward-pointing spur
The 'R' has a graceful, curved leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display serif paired with a small, utilitarian sans-serif for metadata.

avoid: Sans-serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classical, sharp serif feel with a metallic potential.
Standard for cinematic, high-contrast serif display.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a woman with warm amber lighting, shimmering glitter skin texture, large gold hoop earrings, and heavy film grain. The background should be dark and out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in the bottom left corner using a bold, beveled gold serif font with high contrast and sharp terminals.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm-toned?
Does the typography have a 3D beveled appearance?
Is the grain texture consistent across the entire image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-quality skin retouching with glitter integration

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting direction on the face and text.
Ensure the starburst glint is positioned correctly on the earring.
Verify the grain does not obscure the clarity of the eyes.
Confirm the gold texture of the text matches the warmth of the lighting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Portrait + Shimmer Skin + Large Hoops + Beveled Gold Serif + Heavy Film Grain
